claims.statement: For A=[[B,W],[W^T,C]], D=diag(B,C), if A has p eigenvalues >=1 and q eigenvalues <=-1, then for every r>=0 D has at least max(p-r,0) eigenvalues >=1-s_{r+1}(W) and at least max(q-r,0) eigenvalues <=-(1-s_{r+1}(W)).

On the account03/B20 r46 heavy-arm branch after r44 globalisation, either the full law is paid by the physical E3 receiver with density <541, or if s2(W)>=1/2 then s1(W),s2(W)>=1/2 and dist_F(W,rank<=2)<2^-16. The retained coefficient tail is not deleted.
For the actual global original-coordinate cut W, e5(W^T W)>=1/1024 implies ||p_Q||_infinity<=10 sqrt(2e)<23.317 by the pinned unrestricted D5 theorem.

Pay the strong global rank-two crossing tube, the side-spectrum branch retaining signed principal-block modes, or the r46 four-bank rank<=12 carrier, with arbitrary same-bank curvature and all nonzero tails retained.
